title: TheGen
tagline: Farcaster Frame for creators with temporary 'stories' gated by paid monthly membership.
description:
Farcaster Frame for creators with temporary 'stories' that are visible on user's profile for only 24 hours after upload and are token gated by paid monthly membership and authentication using Farcaster id. When user wants to acces story he either need to already have active subscribtion for the creator or he can purchase it right away using in-frame onchain transaction.

Slide deck: https://www.canva.com/design/DAGDETKw7CY/NHSSbzpSBemLddQcn3JKXg/edit?utm_content=DAGDETKw7CY&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton
how_its_made: Project utilizes frog for customizable frames for which config is stored on the IPFS using Pinata, in the future backend would also encrypted the data afer user upload and before storing it on IPFS. Payments for subscribtions and verification of subscribtion periods are verified through smart contract on Arbitrum and Base testnet.
